title: Four Adjectives That Do Not Agree
label: ch:hi-adjectives-that-do-not-bend
canDo: I can say easy, difficult, beautiful and ugly, and tell from an adjective's ending whether it will change to match its noun.

payoff.summary: Name all four adjectives and say which of them would change ending before a feminine noun: none, because a Hindi adjective bends only when it ends in -aa.
payoff.note: Closes HI-A1-LEX-06 (ease and difficulty) and HI-A1-LEX-04 (attractiveness) together, because all four words land on the same side of the agreement rule chapter 41 already taught. The chapter teaches no new grammar: it reuses the -aa test and the kaalaa/safed contrast from chapter 11, so four A1 adjectives cost the learner one observation rather than four memorisations.
